meta_state_law_citations_007.answer:
"Pending disciplinary action, a teacher may follow the procedures under s. 1003.32 F.S., and school board policy for removal of the student from the class."
"In cases where a teacher determines a student behavior interferes with the teacher’s ability to communicate effectively with the students in the class or with the ability of the student’s classmates to learn, the teacher may remove the student from class consistent with School Board policy and the provisions of Section 1003.32, Florida Statutes."
"Consistent with Florida law, discipline is the responsibility of all personnel in the school."
"The Board agrees to review the possibility of paying out terminal pay upon separation consistent with state law and board policy."
"However, none of the above provisions shall be implied to supersede the Superintendent's authority as established in Florida Statutes."
